method: Expectations transcribed from independently extracted Table 11 and Table 12 source cells. selectedImplementation and E1 fixtures are excluded as numerical authorities. Row IDs locate raw literals in sourceRecordFile. Release versions are implementation identity metadata, not source facts.

interpretation.historicalAllocations: Each first-release row supplies one indicative historical allocation equal to its four stage cells. No alternate allocation is claimed.
interpretation.plantingMonths: Month labels become full calendar months and remain recommendations. March/Apr covers March and April. This tests the declared representation, not a hard agronomic constraint.
interpretation.standardConditions: Table 12 assumes standard non-stressed, well-managed crops in subhumid conditions near RHmin 45 percent and 2 m/s wind. Initial Kc changes with wetting. These reviewed assumptions are not verified field conditions.

turnaround.reason: Gilir author scheduling assumption. FAO-56 does not publish a seven-day turnaround.
